scenario_config.scenario_description: Assign HR Systems skill to designated users, create an active assignment rule for high-priority HR portal cases, and announce the new routing configuration in the ServiceNow Community channel.
scenario_config.prompt: We keep misrouting HR portal issues to the wrong queue. Find the HR Systems skill and assign it to John Ramirez and Carl Brown. Create an active assignment rule named "HR Portal - HR Systems Coverage" that routes high-priority cases to users with the HR Systems skill. Send a message in the product feedback channel of the ServiceNow Community team explaining the new routing configuration.

verifier_configs.sql_query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS count FROM assignment_rules WHERE name = 'HR Portal - HR Systems Coverage' AND active = 1 AND based_on_priority = 'high' AND based_on_skills LIKE '%12%'

body.content:
New HR Portal Routing Configuration

Effective immediately, we have implemented an improved routing system for HR portal issues to reduce misrouting to wrong queues.

Changes Made:

  • Skill Assignment: The 'HR Systems' skill has been assigned to John Ramirez and Carl Brown
  • New Assignment Rule: Created active rule 'HR Portal - HR Systems Coverage'
  • Routing Logic: All high-priority HR cases requiring the HR Systems skill will now be automatically routed to these qualified agents

This ensures that HR portal issues are handled by team members with the specific technical expertise needed, improving resolution time and accuracy.

Please direct any questions about this new configuration to the HR Systems team.
